name: PIG 64
desc:
DISCLAIMER: PIG 64 is what people may refer to as an ARG, and will require out-of-the-box thinking, but also travelling outside of the game for answers.

Controls:
Double Jump - Press jump twice
Float - Press jump when all other jumps are used
Roll / Dash / Long Jump - Shift (Computer), Tap (Mobile) or Left Trigger (Console)
Tool Abilities - F (Computer), Tap (Mobile) or Right Trigger (Console)
Emote - G (Computer), Tap (Mobile) or Y/Triangle (Console)
